summary: The customer called to complain about an unexpected thirty-dollar increase in their bill, claiming their promotional rate was guaranteed for two years and they never agreed to a renewal. The agent verified the account, noted a confirmation recording exists from November 12th, and escalated the dispute to a supervisor as requested by the customer.

evidence.text: I can escalate this to my supervisor right away.
evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: Escalate the unauthorized renewal dispute to a supervisor.

evidence.text: I certainly understand your frustration regarding an unexpected price increase.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent acknowledged the customer's frustration clearly and empathetically at the beginning of the call.

evidence.text: Thank you for calling Metro Telecom, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent maintained a professional and calm demeanor throughout despite the customer's aggressive tone.

evidence.text: I see the confirmation recording on file from November 12th. However, if you'd like to dispute the authorization, I can escalate this to my supervisor right away.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent could not instantly reverse the charge due to policy, but offered an appropriate escalation path to resolve the dispute.

evidence.text: Let me pull up your account to review the contract details.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent clearly explained every step they were taking, such as pulling up the account and checking the file.

evidence.text: Yes, do it now, and I expect this fixed before the end of the day or I am switching providers.
evidence.speaker: Customer

rubric_scores.justification: The call ended abruptly on the customer's ultimatum without a proper formal closing from the agent.

evidence.text: I see a contract renewal was processed last month.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent accurately retrieved account contract details and confirmation recording dates from the system.

evidence.text: I can escalate this to my supervisor right away.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent followed proper protocol by offering an escalation when a customer disputed an authorized renewal.

quote.text: I am calling because my bill just went up by thirty dollars, and I am furious.
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: You better figure it out fast, because I don't have all day to sit on hold while you look at my file.
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: I never agreed to any renewal! Someone signed me up without my permission, and I want this charge reversed immediately.
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: Yes, do it now, and I expect this fixed before the end of the day or I am switching providers.
quote.speaker: Customer
